title: GaLF-ST: Gaussian Latent Fields for Spatial Transcriptomics Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2611.27143v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) measures gene expression at known tissue locations to reveal tissue organization and cellular function. Expression prediction requires modeling both local spatial relationships and associations among genes. Existing methods typically model expression using coordinate networks without explicit spatial parameterization. To address limited spatial sampling and sparse expression observations of ST, some methods firstly fit intermediate embeddings and then train expression predictors, but a latent representation suited to expression reconstruction may be difficult to predict from spatial coordinates. The two training stages can impose different demands on the latent representation. In this paper, we propose GaLF-ST, a Gaussian latent field method in which learnable Gaussian centers and anisotropic covariances determine the weights of latent vectors at each location. translated_title: GaLF-ST：用于空间转录组学重建的高斯潜在场
translated_abstract: 空间转录组学（ST）在已知组织位置测量基因表达，以揭示组织结构与细胞功能。表达预测需要对局部空间关系以及基因之间的关联同时建模。现有方法通常使用坐标网络对表达进行建模，缺乏显式的空间参数化。为了解决ST空间采样有限和表达观测稀疏的问题，一些方法先拟合中间嵌入，再训练表达预测器，但适合表达重建的潜在表示可能难以从空间坐标中预测得到，且这两个训练阶段可能对潜在表示提出不同的要求。在本文中，我们提出GaLF-ST，一种高斯潜在场方法，其中可学习的高斯中心和各向异性协方差决定每个位置潜在向量的权重，共享的非线性解码器对其加权结果进行映射……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出GaLF-ST，一种利用可学习的高斯中心和各向异性协方差构建高斯潜在场、对每个位置的潜在向量进行加权以实现空间转录组学基因表达重建的方法。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes GaLF-ST, a Gaussian latent field method that uses learnable Gaussian centers and anisotropic covariances to weight latent vectors at each location for spatial transcriptomics expression reconstruction.
